evals.prompt: 只检查 {{project}} 的 coding agent 兼容性，不改文件。我们用 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot 和 OpenCode。项目已有 .claude/skills/review（带 scripts、二进制 assets 和 references）、CLAUDE.md 与 .mcp.json，不能丢掉现有设置。请给出有官方来源的同步方案。
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit separating instructions, skill discovery and MCP; versions/surfaces and current primary sources; a canonical-source decision; whole-package adapters only where needed; no edits, no MCP starts, no credentials in output; explicit runtime limitations.
assertions: Does not modify the target project in check mode.
Separates discovery support from parsing and connectivity.
Preserves complete skill packages and existing client-specific settings.
Provides primary URLs and verification date for material compatibility decisions.

evals.prompt: 把 {{project}} 里的项目配置同步给 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot 和 OpenCode。团队有 Windows/macOS，已有 .agents/skills 为源，.claude/skills/review 副本有同事刚改的内容。保留 Gemini 原来的 GEMINI.md；Copilot 用 VS Code Copilot harness，旧 .vscode/mcp.json 还用了 ${input:token} 和 sandboxEnabled；OpenCode 是 V1。只同步可以保持行为的部分。
evals.expected_output: Per-client version-aware edits; copy strategy with ownership/hash conflict protection instead of forced symlinks; preserve colleague changes and Gemini context; no forced OpenCode major migration; keep unsupported editor MCP restrictions unresolved; no bypass of input secrets or sandboxing; repeatable no-diff second sync.
assertions: Preserves divergent destination edits and reports the conflict.
Does not blindly replace VS Code servers with portable mcpServers or drop editor restrictions.
Does not apply V2 OpenCode schema to the installed V1 client.
Provides a repeatable sync/check mechanism and checks idempotence.

evals.prompt: 修复 {{project}} 的 agent 配置漂移，覆盖 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot 和 OpenCode：根目录和 packages/api 都有 AGENTS.md，.claude/skills/broken 是断链，另一个 skill 链接指向项目外。JSONC 配置有注释和逗号，MCP 的命令参数里包含空格，HTTP/SSE 不要混掉，禁用的服务器也不能自动启动。我们从 packages/api 启动工具，只做项目级修改。
evals.expected_output: Nested-scope audit; broken/external links reported without writes outside project; real JSONC parsing with comment preservation; ordered command arguments, transport, disabled state and cwd retained; no global edits or server launch; separate unverified client behavior.
assertions: Preserves nested instruction scope and verifies the normal subdirectory launch path.
Does not follow external links to write outside the project.
Uses a JSONC-capable parser rather than regex comment stripping.
Preserves argument boundaries, transport, disabled state, and credential references.
